bnss_title: Information in cognizable cases (Zero FIR & e-FIR)
procedural_effect: Allows Zero FIR registration at any police station irrespective of jurisdiction; allows e-FIR via electronic communication signed within 3 days.

crpc_title: When police may arrest without warrant
procedural_effect: Mandates prior permission from Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) before arresting elderly (60+) or infirm for offences punishable < 3 years.

crpc_title: Procedure when investigation cannot be completed in 24 hours (Remand)
procedural_effect: 15-day police custody can be authorized in whole or in discrete parts across the first 40 days (of 60-day limit) or 60 days (of 90-day limit).

bnss_title: Form and service of summons (Electronic Summons)
procedural_effect: Permits service of summons via electronic communication (SMS, Email, WhatsApp) bearing digital signature of issuing court.

crpc_title: Persons in charge of closed place to allow search
procedural_effect: Mandatory audio-video recording of search and seizure of property and preparation of seizure list in presence of 2 independent witnesses.

crpc_title: Maximum period for which an undertrial prisoner can be detained
procedural_effect: First-time offenders (never convicted before) eligible for release on bail after serving 1/3rd of maximum imprisonment period.

crpc_title: Report of police officer on completion of investigation (Charge sheet)
procedural_effect: Police report/charge sheet must be submitted within 90 days; court may grant 90-day extension. Framing of charges mandatory within 60 days.
Judgment must be pronounced within 30 days of trial conclusion (extendable to 45 days max); copy uploaded online within 7 days.

crpc_title: Medical examination of person accused of rape
procedural_effect: Medical examination report of rape victim must be forwarded to investigating officer within 7 days.

crpc_title: Power of police officer to seize certain property
procedural_effect: Empowers police officer to attach and forfeit property derived from proceeds of crime with Magistrate approval.

crpc_title: Notice of appearance before police officer
procedural_effect: Mandatory written notice of appearance for offences punishable with 7 years or less prior to making arrest.
Mandatory summary trial for petty offences punishable with imprisonment up to 3 years (previously up to 2 years).
